name: app-blue-palette-wheel-and-bricolage-type-slide
title: Blue Palette Wheel and Bricolage Grotesque
whatItIs: A pale periwinkle slide with a title, a paragraph, a circular palette of four rounded quarter segments (white, ice, blue, charcoal) around a blue logo disc, and a huge black 'Bricolage Grotesque' specimen below.
whatItMeans: The ring turns a colour list into a single graphic object, and the huge typeface name makes the type choice unmistakable.
techniques: Palette shown as a segmented ring with hex chips
Logo sitting in the centre of the palette
Plane icon riding a progress bar as page indicator
Giant one-line specimen as the bottom anchor
Soft radial blue glows in the background

vocabulary.definition: Colours arranged as segments of a circle.
A bar that shows position through a document, here with a plane icon.
A single line of text set large to display a typeface.
